_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: string
card_product.network: visa | mastercard | rupay | amex | diners | N/A
bin_ranges: string array of BINs, [] if unknown
card_product.joining_fee_inr: number | 0 if free | N/A if fee model doesn't apply (e.g. prepaid)
card_product.point_value_inr_baseline: number — ₹ per reward point/mile, used to normalize accrual to a %; N/A for pure-cashback cards (no points unit)
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: string explaining how the baseline was derived | N/A
card_product.point_expiry_months: number | null (never expires => 0, unknown => null) | N/A for cashback cards
card_product.confirmed_flat_base_outside_smartbuy_or_: boolean — true only if verified the card has no other category accelerators beyond what's listed | N/A if the card has no portal-style accelerator program at all

eligibility_engine.evaluation_mode: guideline_only | all_pass | any_pass | N/A (open-application cards with no underwriting gate published)

rules.parameter: string, e.g. cibil_score | net_monthly_salary_inr | age_years | employment_type

community_benchmarks.is_contractually_enforceable: boolean — false when these are observed heuristics, not published rules

accrual_engine.base_block_inr: number — the ₹ block one accrual unit is computed against, e.g. 150 | N/A for flat-cashback cards with no block model
accrual_engine.base_points_per_block: number | N/A (cashback cards use base_cashback_percent instead)
accrual_engine.base_cashback_percent: number | N/A (points cards use base_points_per_block instead)
accrual_engine.effective_base_return_percent: number — the resolved %, always fill this even if one of the two above is N/A

reward_rules.category_id: string — PandaPay internal category taxonomy key, e.g. fuel | grocery | dining | travel_flights | travel_hotels | gift_vouchers | education | utility | excluded_spend | all_retail
reward_rules.rail: any | upi_qr | swipe | online | contactless | atm | emi | smartbuy_or_equivalent_portal | pos_terminal
reward_rules.conditions: condition-tree object — kept for source fidelity even though the engine ingest step flattens this to category_id/rail/merchant_pattern

mcc_target_list: number array | N/A if the cap isn't MCC-scoped
cap_rules.period: day | statement_cycle | calendar_month | quarter | half_year | annual | lifetime
cap_rules.limit_value: number | N/A if limit_value_inr is used instead
cap_rules.limit_value_inr: number | N/A if limit_value (points/count) is used instead
cap_rules.parent_cap_id: string | null — for sub-caps nested under a parent cap

apr.monthly_interest_rate_percent: number | N/A for charge cards with no revolving credit

forex_markup.markup_percent: number | N/A for cards with no forex use case

fuel_surcharge.waiver_percent: number | N/A — 0 if card has surcharge but no waiver

cash_advance.atm_transaction_fee_inr: number | N/A for debit/prepaid cards (no cash-advance concept)

exempted_channels: [] if the fee is charged on every channel

components: array of formula strings or numeric floors

annual_fee_waiver.threshold_spend_inr: number | N/A for lifetime-free cards with no fee to waive

lifestyle_and_network_benefits.category_id: lounge | golf | dining | concierge | insurance_related_perk | movie | other
lifestyle_and_network_benefits.network_program: string — controlled vocabulary shared across issuers, e.g. priority_pass, visa_infinite, mastercard_world_elite
lifestyle_and_network_benefits.label: string

insurance_and_protection.cover_type: air_accidental_death | medical_emergency_overseas | credit_shield | baggage_loss_delay | purchase_protection | extended_warranty | other
insurance_and_protection.coverage_inr: number | N/A if quoted in a foreign currency instead
insurance_and_protection.coverage_usd: number | N/A if quoted in INR instead

direct_options.inr_value_per_point: number | N/A for cashback cards (no points to redeem)
